trend_conclusions: Intentional prototyping with agents and native previews raises iteration speed, while critical human judgment remains the quality gate.
Current Apple guidance favors familiar system components in the functional UI layer and distinctive expression through content, typography, color, iconography and tuned interaction.
Liquid Glass is a functional control and navigation material, not a blanket content-layer style.
Realistic data, long text, empty and error states, accessibility settings and key motion moments belong in prototypes before visual polish is accepted.
External SwiftUI repositories remain references until project-specific license, build, accessibility and maintenance review.
